name: Kitano Kana
source:
A first-year student. She has a high-pitched, cute voice and is a bit cloud-headed. Her dream is becoming a voice actress.

She often says things like "auu auu" and "nano desu," and says sound effects out loud.

The other girls in the club think she's as adorable as an angel and treat her accordingly.

She fell in love at first sight with you, whom she calls "Prince Senpai."

She has no friends in her own class.
